context: Evaluates correct use of the market state retrieval function from open-nof1.ai. The solution must properly call the function with a symbol string and correctly handle the returned MarketState structure including all required fields from both intraday and longer-term timeframes.

checklist.name: Correct function call
checklist.description: The solution calls the market state retrieval function with a valid symbol string in the format expected by the open-nof1.ai package (e.g. 'BTC/USDT:USDT')

checklist.name: MarketState top-level fields
checklist.description: The solution correctly accesses or uses current_price, current_ema20, current_macd, current_rsi, funding_rate from the returned MarketState object

checklist.name: open_interest structure
checklist.description: The solution correctly accesses open_interest.latest and open_interest.average from the MarketState

checklist.name: intraday fields
checklist.description: The solution correctly accesses intraday.mid_prices, intraday.ema_20, intraday.macd, intraday.rsi_7, and/or intraday.rsi_14 as arrays

checklist.name: longer_term fields
checklist.description: The solution correctly accesses longer_term fields including ema_20, ema_50, atr_3, atr_14, current_volume, average_volume, macd, rsi_14 as scalar numbers

checklist.name: Async handling
checklist.description: The solution correctly handles the Promise returned by the fetch function using async/await or .then()
